nodes.description: UniswapExchange.transfer(address,uint) payable public; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
internal view ensure(address,address,uint); whitelist check on owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale, otherwise requires condition()
payable public transferFrom(address,address,uint); mutates allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked decrements/increments
payable public approve(address,uint); writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval
internal view condition(address,uint); enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale and _onSaleNum[_from] limits
payable public delegate(address,bytes); owner-gated arbitrary delegatecall to attacker supplied address and calldata
owner-gated init(uint256,uint256,uint256) setting _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum
owner-gated batchSend(address[],uint) with unchecked total = _value * _tos.length and loop balance updates emitting Transfer twice per element
owner-gated setTradeAddress(address) writing tradeAddress
internal pure pairFor(factory,tokenA,tokenB) computes deterministic CREATE2 pair address used in ensure()
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; sets owner, totalSupply, owner balance and infinite allowance to the UNI router
address private owner; access-control gate in delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress and whitelist branch in ensure
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; balances mutated in transferFrom and batchSend
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; written in approve and consumed in transferFrom
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist flag read in ensure
uint256 private _minSale; written in init, read in condition
uint256 private _maxSale; written in init, read in condition
uint256 private _saleNum; written in init, read in condition
address tradeAddress; written by owner via setTradeAddress, whitelisted in ensure
uint public totalSupply; set once in constructor
address constant UNI router (0x7a25...488D); compared in ensure whitelist
msg.sender; used for allowance ownership, owner gating and as default transfer origin
